CORNER_ATTACK: Corner opportunity (corners won) + Corner efficiency (xG per corner delivery + first contact rate)
CORNER_DEFENCE: Corner suppression (corners conceded) + Corner defensive efficiency (xGA per corner conceded)
INDIRECT_FK_ATTACK: Wide & deep free kick delivery threat and 18-yard box aerial entries
INDIRECT_FK_DEFENCE: Suppression of dangerous FK concessions and aerial clearance rate
AERIAL_SETPIECE_ATTACK: Aerial duel success on offensive set pieces in 18-yard box
AERIAL_SETPIECE_DEFENCE: Defensive aerial clearance rate in 18-yard box
SECOND_BALL_ATTACK: Turnover regain rate within 5s of set-piece delivery into penalty area
SECOND_BALL_DEFENCE: Defensive clearance recovery and transition breakout prevention
